title: RPA per-IBZ-q scalar needs q-star time-reversal averaging or Total EcRPA keeps a spurious imaginary part
symptom: In the first k444 symmetry RPA test the real part was correct but the accumulated total energy retained an obvious imaginary part.
root_cause: `symrot_k.txt` places `TRS * ...` members inside the same k/q star (k444 is a concrete example), so a scalar accumulated on the irreducible representative is not real on its own. The star average must combine the spatial star members with their time-reversed partners; when the star already contains -q the scalar is simply real.
minimal_fix: Average the scalar contribution over the star inside the energy accumulation: F_star(q) = (n_s F(q) + n_t F(q)*) / (n_s + n_t), and when -q is already in the star take Re F(q). Apply the same treatment to the RPA weight w_q. RPA needs no W_c: only the ABF block rotation / little-group average of V(q) and chi0(q, iw) before Tr{V chi0} and logdet{1 - V chi0}.
validation: No imaginary-part warning and no residual imaginary component in Total EcRPA; the k444 symmetry-on value must match the symmetry=-1 full-q run exactly at printed precision (`-0.342512415 Ha`).
avoid: Do not just discard the imaginary part of the total, and do not reuse the GW W_c path for the RPA scalar - the RPA integrand is Tr{V chi0} + logdet, not a screened-interaction quantity.
